name: Affine Arithmetic Early Skip Test
definition: A constant-time test to detect if a ray does not collide with the object within a working interval, providing a better starting point if it cannot be skipped. It uses an underestimation of the leading coefficient of a degree 2 polynomial approximation.
summary: The Affine Arithmetic Early Skip Test is a constant-time heuristic that detects non-collisions in distance-field ray marching by bounding polynomial uncertainty, avoiding expensive root-finding operations.
